concerns.text: The success criterion SC‑001 (≥80 % subjects successfully preprocessed) is not covered by any task; no verification step measures or asserts the preprocessing success rate.

SC‑003 requires the false‑positive rate to be ≤ 0.05, yet task T076 only logs the observed FPR without halting or failing the pipeline if the threshold is exceeded, effectively weakening the requirement.

SC‑004 mandates reproducibility via bootstrap stability verification, but tasks T059a‑c generate bootstrap results without any validation step that checks reproducibility against a benchmark or reference.
SC‑005 demands test‑retest reliability (ICC ≥ 0.7) for network metrics; no task implements a test‑retest validation or records ICC values, leaving the acceptance criterion unaddressed.

SC‑002 specifies a 6‑hour runtime limit; task T009 only monitors memory and runtime warnings but there is no task that measures total pipeline runtime and enforces the 6‑hour bound, so the acceptance criterion is omitted.
